declarations.name: AuiDiagram

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the diagram (canvas); the node list is named '{label}: nodes', the connection list '{label}: connections', and the toolbar '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

inputs.name: editable
inputs.description: Edit mode: palette, ports, moving, connecting, reconnecting, inline labels, copy and paste, delete, marquee selection, undo and redo.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Auto-layout settings { algorithm?: 'layered' | 'tree', direction?: 'TB' | 'BT' | 'LR' | 'RL', nodeGap?, rankGap?, sweeps?, keepPositions? }. Given on create, the layout runs once (keepPositions keeps nodes that have positions). Also the defaults of layout() and of placing nodes without positions.

inputs.name: palette
inputs.description: Shapes offered in edit mode: { shape, label, width?, height? }. Default: Step (rounded), Decision (diamond), Start or end (ellipse), Process, Input or output, Document, Database.

inputs.name: renderShape
inputs.description: Draws nodes with shape 'custom' ({ width, height, selected, doc } context): return SVG content in local coordinates. The label is drawn on top; return non-interactive content.

inputs.name: canConnect
inputs.description: Veto new and changed connections (pointer, keyboard, addEdge). Self connections and exact duplicates are always refused (announced).

inputs.name: historyLimit
inputs.description: Undo depth, integer 0..500 (0 disables history).

inputs.name: showGrid
inputs.description: Dotted grid on the canvas in edit mode.

inputs.name: nodeWidth
inputs.description: Default node width, integer 40..800 diagram px.

inputs.name: nodeHeight
inputs.description: Default node height, integer 24..600 diagram px.

inputs.name: gridSize
inputs.description: Grid spacing (snap, keyboard move step, grid dots), integer 4..200.

inputs.name: snapToGrid
inputs.description: Snap moved and added nodes to the grid (keyboard moves step by gridSize; off: 1 px).

inputs.name: routing
inputs.description: Default edge routing (an edge's own routing wins).

inputs.name: nodeGap
inputs.description: Auto-layout space between neighbors of one rank, integer 8..400.

inputs.name: rankGap
inputs.description: Auto-layout space between ranks, integer 16..600.

inputs.name: minZoom
inputs.description: Smallest zoom factor, 0.05..1.

inputs.name: maxZoom
inputs.description: Largest zoom factor, 1..8.

inputs.name: textAlternative
inputs.description: Nodes and connections table below the canvas: behind a Show text description button (toggle), always shown, visually hidden but available to screen readers, or none.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages, counts, and zoom percentages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors auto-layout and the reading order of nodes; arrow keys stay spatial.

models.name: model
models.description: JSON model { nodes, edges, groups? }. Node: { id, label, shape? ('rectangle' | 'rounded' (default) | 'ellipse' | 'diamond' | 'parallelogram' | 'cylinder' | 'document' | 'custom'), x?, y?, width?, height? (16..2000), ports? ({ id, side, offset? }; default one per side: top, right, bottom, left), group?, pinned?, locked?, data? }. Edge: { id, from, to, fromPort?, toPort?, label?, routing?, arrowStart? (default 'none'), arrowEnd? (default 'arrow'; 'none' | 'arrow' | 'triangle' | 'diamond' | 'circle'), dashed?, data? }. Group: { id, label }. Validated (DIAGRAM_OPTIONS). Nodes without x/y are placed by auto-layout. Replacing it with update() clears the undo history.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The model changed through the UI or an API method. Save detail.model.

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: The selection changed through the UI (click, Shift-click, marquee, Space, Ctrl/Cmd+A, Escape, paste, delete). select() does not emit.

outputs.name: nodeActivated
outputs.description: A node was activated: Enter or double-click in view mode, or double-click on a locked node in edit mode.

outputs.name: zoomed
outputs.description: The zoom changed through the toolbar, keys, Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, or zoomTo (fit does not emit).

methods.name: select
methods.description: Replace the selection with these node and edge ids (no event).

methods.name: focusNode
methods.description: Focus a node and pan it into view.

methods.name: addNode
methods.signature: addNode(node: Partial<DiagramNode> & { label: string; }): string | undefined
methods.description: Add a node; id, size, and position are filled in (position: a free spot at the view center). Undoable; emits aui-change ('add'); returns the id.

methods.name: addEdge
methods.signature: addEdge(edge: Partial<DiagramEdge> & { from: string; to: string; }): string | null | undefined
methods.description: Connect two nodes; null when refused (self, duplicate, canConnect). Undoable; emits aui-change ('connect').

methods.name: updateNode
methods.description: Change one node or edge (validated). Undoable; emits aui-change ('update').

methods.name: updateEdge
methods.description: Change one node or edge (validated). Undoable; emits aui-change ('update').

methods.name: moveNode
methods.signature: moveNode(id: string, x: number, y: number): void
methods.description: Move a node (snapped when snapToGrid). Undoable; emits aui-change ('move').

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove nodes (with their edges) and edges. Undoable; emits aui-change ('delete').

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last edit (whole-model snapshots). Announce and emit aui-change ('undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Undo / redo the last edit (whole-model snapshots). Announce and emit aui-change ('undo' / 'redo'); false when there is nothing to undo/redo.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copy the selected nodes and the edges between them into the instance clipboard; paste them offset by two grid steps (new ids), select them, emit aui-change ('paste').

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Copy the selected nodes and the edges between them into the instance clipboard; paste them offset by two grid steps (new ids), select them, emit aui-change ('paste').

methods.name: editLabel
methods.description: Open the inline label editor of a node or edge (edit mode). Enter or blur commits, Escape cancels.

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Scale (at most 100 %) and center the drawing; announces the zoom.

methods.name: zoomTo
methods.description: Zoom around the viewport center, clamped to minZoom..maxZoom; announces and emits aui-zoom.

methods.name: centerOn
methods.description: Center the view on a node.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Plain-text description: one line per node with its shape and connections.

accessibility.pattern: A focusable canvas (group, roledescription 'canvas') containing two multi-select listboxes, one for nodes and one for connections, each with one roving tab stop (WAI-ARIA APG listbox, with spatial arrow navigation for nodes). Each node's accessible name states its label, shape, and connections; a text alternative table lists every node with what it leads to and comes from. Edits have keyboard and single-pointer paths (no deprecated ARIA drag-and-drop attributes) and are announced through live regions.

limitations: Edges are routed between their end points only; they do not avoid other nodes (layered layout keeps most edges clear).
Every node and edge is rendered (no virtualization); sized for hundreds of nodes.
Groups are drawn as boxes around their members; swimlanes and nested groups are not provided.
Nodes are resized through the model (updateNode), not by dragging handles.
A plain mouse wheel scrolls the page; zooming needs Ctrl/Cmd + wheel, the toolbar, or keys. Pinch zoom is not provided.
Reconnecting by keyboard means deleting the connection and connecting again.
Export draws custom shapes as rounded rectangles.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
